verdict.rationale: Granola's mobile app is documented for AI-enhanced notes during in-person meetings, plus phone calls on iOS. Transcription languages are documented for both iOS and Android, and the workspace is searchable via Chat and MCP. However, no evidence explicitly says mobile-captured notes sync into the same desktop/team workspace; that is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of mobile-to-workspace sync and search over mobile-captured notes, independent hands-on corroboration of mobile in-person recording.
